alert.title: Alert threshold
alert.intro: Highlight this widget while you have the dashboard open and its value crosses the threshold you set.
alert.scopeNote: Checked only while this dashboard is open and its tab is visible — nothing runs in the background.
alert.manageDescription: Threshold rules on this dashboard. A rule that is off is not checked and shows no alert; turned back on, its count starts again.
alert.manageEmpty: No alert rules on this dashboard yet. Add one from a widget's menu → Alert threshold.
alert.manageToggle: Turn the alert rule of {widget} on or off
alert.removeConfirmMessage: Only the rule is removed. The widget stays on the dashboard.
alert.unsupportedWidget: This widget does not expose a value that can be monitored.
alert.noCanonicalMetric: This widget has no metric that can be monitored.
alert.thresholdNotFinite: The threshold must be a number.
alert.thresholdNegative: This metric can't be negative, so a negative threshold would make the alert meaningless. Enter 0 or more.
alert.thresholdHint: Enter the threshold in the same units as the current value.
alert.consecutive: Only trigger after N checks in a row
alert.consecutiveHint: Fires only after N valid checks in a row meet the condition. A check that doesn't, finds no data or fails to read never fires it and starts the count again.
alert.consecutiveRequired: Enter how many checks in a row.
alert.consecutiveInvalid: Checks in a row must be a whole number of 1 or more.
alert.metricRequired: Choose a metric this platform provides.
alert.otherMetricHint: {metric} isn't shown on this widget; its value is read at the first check. Enter the threshold in {metric}'s unit.
alert.larkEnable: Also send to a Lark group
alert.larkChannelRequired: Choose a Lark channel, or turn sending off.
alert.larkChannelMissing: The saved channel no longer exists. Choose another one.
alert.larkLoadFailed: Couldn't load the Lark channels. Close and try again.
alert.larkNoChannels: This workspace has no Lark channel yet. An administrator can add one in Settings → Integrations → Lark.
alert.larkNote: Lark: one message per breach. After N checks in a row meet the condition, the server reads the number again before sending; it sends again only after a check that no longer meets it.
alert.emailHint: Up to {max} addresses, separated by commas or new lines. Each must be a member of this workspace or an address verified in Verified destinations.
alert.emailRequired: Enter at least one email address, or turn email off.
alert.emailNotVerified: Not a member of this workspace or a verified destination: {list}. Verify them, or remove them.
alert.emailCheckFailed: Couldn't check the recipients right now. Try again, or turn email off.
alert.emailUnavailable: Email alerts aren't available in this workspace. Turn email off to save.
alert.emailNote: Email: each recipient gets one email per breach. After N checks in a row meet the condition, the server reads the number again before sending; it emails again only after a check that no longer meets it.
alert.linkInternalNote: Opens the dashboard in Cluega. Each recipient must sign in and be allowed to view this dashboard — receiving the alert grants no access, and the members of a Lark group cannot be checked one by one.
alert.linkShareNote: Uses this dashboard's existing share link while it is active. Anyone with the link (and its password, if set) can open it. Alerts never create, turn on or extend the link.
alert.linkShareFailed: Could not check the share link.
alert.linkShareLiveUntil: The share link is active until {date}.
alert.linkSharePassword: It is password-protected: recipients will need the password.
alert.linkShareNone: This dashboard has no active share link. Create one in Share first.
alert.linkShareExpired: The share link has expired. Create a new one in Share.
alert.linkShareHeld: Until it is active again, this rule's alerts are held, not sent.
alert.linkNote: The link applies to Lark and email alike. The server checks the share link each time it sends; if it is not active, the alert is held and tried again at the next check — never sent with another link.
alert.linkSaveUnavailable: The alert was not saved: this dashboard has no active share link. Create or turn on one in Share, or choose the internal link, then save again.
alert.linkSaveExpired: The alert was not saved: the dashboard's share link has expired. Create a new one in Share, or choose the internal link, then save again.
alert.emailSaveRefused: The dashboard wasn't saved: {list} can't receive alert emails. Open the widget's alert threshold and verify or remove them.
alert.emailSaveUnavailable: The dashboard wasn't saved: email alerts aren't available in this workspace. Turn email off on the widget's alert threshold.
alert.introChannels: Highlight this widget, and optionally notify Lark or email, when its value crosses your threshold.
alert.channelsNone: No channel selected: the alert only highlights this widget on the dashboard.

timeRange.widened: Widened because the requested range has no stored data.
timeRange.widenedFiltered: Widened because the filter {filters} matches no rows in the requested range.
timeRange.exhausted: Checked back to the {days}-day limit ({range}) and no data is stored — this is not a measured zero. Check the connection, switch accounts or ask a different question.
timeRange.exhaustedFiltered: No rows match the filter {filters} in {range} — checked back to the {days}-day limit. Widen or remove the filter.
timeRange.interrupted: Could not widen: the stored data for {range} could not be read. Refresh to try again.
timeRange.unconfirmed: Not widened: the data for {range} could not be verified, so this cannot be read as no data.
timeRange.mixed: The widgets on this board differ in data period or widening status. See the period on each widget.
